messages:
elaine (Design): Quick design review — I pushed an updated Notification Matrix + compact preview for the Alerting & SLO config page. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/notify-matrix (screenshots + prototype). Looking for quick takes on: keyboard nav, copy for 'Suppress' vs 'Silence', and stacked-channel contrast.

michael (PM): Loving the compact preview. One product ask: can the preview show an example alert title + which channels will fire? helps clarity for non-technical users. :eyes:

raj (Frontend): The compact preview is doable. Question: should each channel pill be focusable? Current mock treats them as passive badges. If focusable we need roving tabindex or a listbox pattern.

elaine (Design): Good Q. I prototyped them as focusable so keyboard users can open channel-level settings from the preview (mute, escalation). But if that's heavy we can make a dedicated 'Channels' expand panel. Thoughts?

tess (Accessibility): If pills are actionable they must be keyboard focusable and have clear aria-labels like `aria-label=\"Channel: PagerDuty, open settings\"`. Also contrast: stacked badges drop to 3.2:1 on gray-100 background — that's below 4.5:1 for body text. We should either increase weight or introduce an outline.

olivia (SRE): For SRE workflows I'd prefer quick access from the preview to silence a channel temporarily. Typical flow: incident paging -> silence for maintenance. So focusable pills + shortcut is helpful. But keep default keyboard shortcut discoverable (e.g., press `s` to silence selected channel).

raj (Frontend): Implementation note: roving tabindex + arrow keys seems best. We can make pills a `role=button` with `tabindex=0/ -1` switching. Also will need aria-pressed for muted state.

elaine (Design): Copy question: current mock uses 'Suppress' as the verb. Suggestions: 'Silence', 'Mute channel', 'Temporarily mute'. Which reads best in a modal?

michael (PM): 'Silence' is shorter and familiar to SREs. For broader users 'Temporarily mute' is clearer. Maybe use 'Silence (temporarily)' in small explanatory text.

tess (Accessibility): Prefer clarity: main action = 'Silence' (label), tooltip = 'Silence notifications from this channel for X minutes'. Screen reader should read duration.

elaine (Design): Okay, plan: label = 'Silence', tooltip = 'Silence for 1h · change duration in modal'.

raj (Frontend): Small implementation detail — tooltips must be accessible: `role=tooltip` + `aria-describedby` on trigger. We'll surface a short live region update when silence is applied.

elaine (Design): Another nit — preview heading reads 'Notification Preview'. Suggest 'Who gets notified' or 'Where this alert goes' for clearer language. Michael?

michael (PM): 'Where this alert goes' is friendlier but a bit informal. 'Notification targets' might be too technical. I like 'Who gets notified' for product copy.

tess (Accessibility): Also ensure heading level order and skip links for keyboard users. If the preview is dense we should support the `aria-labelledby` pattern and a skip link to jump to channel settings.

elaine (Design): Good. Styling nit: when more than 5 channels we collapse into a `+N` overflow pill. Current color contrast there is low. Proposal: make overflow pill outline + use same text weight as pills.

olivia (SRE): Overflow behavior needs to show prioritized channels on top (pager, slack, email). Users get confused with alphabetical order. Can we add drag ordering later?

elaine (Design): We'll surface primary channels with a star icon and order by priority in the preview. Drag ordering is a follow-up.

raj (Frontend): JSON example of panel payload for preview (for devs):

```json
{
  "alert_id": "srv-high-latency",
  "preview": {
    "title": "High latency on api/redwood/v1",
    "channels": [
      {"id":"pagerduty","label":"PagerDuty","muted":false},
      {"id":"#alerts-prod","label":"#alerts-prod","muted":false},
      {"id":"email","label":"On-call email","muted":true}
    ]
  }
}
```

elaine (Design): Thanks, that helps. One more accessibility item: keyboard focus visible style should be >= 3px outline + high contrast. Add token for 'focus-ring' in the system.

tess (Accessibility): Yes — and don't rely on `box-shadow` only. Use solid outline for visibility. Also ensure focus order mirrors visual order after any sort/collapse.

michael (PM): Action items: 1) Elaine update copy & overflow visuals. 2) Raj prototype roving tabindex + tooltip pattern. 3) Tess sign off on ARIA labels and contrast numbers. 4) Olivia confirm SRE flows for silence. ETA: end of week?

elaine (Design): I'll update the figma and drop a diff here. Thanks all — ping me if anything blocking. :thumbsup:
